narrative.overview: Light uses a plain white canvas, dark ink, and a restrained blue accent. The app opens to one centered molded SVG rocker.
dos: Preserve the white canvas, ink typography, and localized blue LED glow.
Expose checked state and focus, and respect reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Don't add an outer switch tile or visible ON/OFF words.
